records.subject: You're in -- let's get Cedar Media set up
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Cedar Media* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 (2026-09-16), showing real activity, but no key milestone in 3 days since, no invites sent, no replies to either outreach (email:989f083b, email:0af803fd), and no tickets. Engaged-but-quiet solo admin with 8 days left: moderate-low odds unaided.

draft.subject: Next step on your Cedar Media project
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

You got your first project up last week — nice start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks to that project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your workflow.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that with you — or just reply here and I'll help from my side.

Best,
Chidi
